FadeIn delay 0.1s == 100ms (delay*1000) over a 400ms ease-out opacity+slide, matching the web useMotionPreference(400) FadeIn, with reduce-motion rendering the final state.

All six cards L41-202 are derived in buildSecurityCards(latest, t) and rendered via the shared <StatusCard> (one GlassPanel styles.card == p-4, a header row icon+title styles.cardHeader == flex items-center gap-3 mb-2, the text-2xl value, the text-xs muted desc). The web per-card icon colour == value colour, so each card carries a single `tone` applied to both the glyph and the value via toneStyles. Tailwind colour map: green-400->success, red-400->danger, amber-400->warning, blue-400->accent, purple-400->violet, var(--text-muted)->muted (the ClientUtilitiesSection precedent).

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements (div/h3/p), window/document, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, @/components/ui, @/components/feedback, @/components/motion, Recharts, or Leaflet appear in the native output — only React (useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState/ReactNode), react-native primitives (AccessibilityInfo/Animated/Easing/StyleSheet/View), the native AppText + GlassPanel, and the design tokens. A focused __tests__/SecurityStatusCards.test.tsx (8 tests) exercises the six-skeleton loading grid, all six cards rendering, the fully-secure positive mapping (Locked/Active/Closed/All Closed/Nearby/Disabled), the unlocked mapping (Unlocked/Inactive/Away/Enabled), the raw-doorState passthrough, the windowSummary open/venting count, and the undefined-latest safe defaults.
Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` — see the conversion log for the exact pass output.
